posts.name: Craig
posts.cooked:
Hey, everyone. We here at the Greater Than Games HQ are going to be off for Boston and PAX East, starting tomorrow, 03 March. So what's that mean for you?

First, it means that we may be slow on the trigger with emails or other sorts of communication. We'll probably still be checking occasionally, but it's not going to be the lightning-quick response you usually get from me. We also won't be in the office to ship orders or other packages, since Jodie is driving the truck with all of our goodies.

Secondly, it means that you can come see us! We want you to come by our booth, say hi, play games, and just keep us busy in general.

And finally, it means that there's a Sentinel Tactics Tournament! Don't forget to tune in and watch us on Twitch starting on Saturday. It should be exciting to watch, as more and more people are starting to figure out their strategies. We're definitely excited about watching it ourselves. If you miss the live stream, don't worry; it will all be up on our YouTube channel not long after.

Our moderators (arenson9, Rabit, and Pydro) have things well in hand during our absence. Don't hesitate to keep them busy, too!
